transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
Well... my mind just feels a bit foggy lately. I can't seem to keep my place in my old cataloguing notes at work... and I just can't decide what simple thing to do next. So, I'm here.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

I suppose... yeah. Most days lately, I just end up sitting at the kitchen table. It's... I don't know, it just feels like the color has gone out of everything. I have these old watercolor books I usually like looking at, but... lately they just make me feel heavy. I don't really have the interest.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?

I suppose. I... well, I mostly have to remind myself to eat these days. My wife is the one who really pointed it out. She notices I leave my rice and soup half-finished... which isn't like me. I never used to waste a meal. Just... haven't felt like it.
Have you noticed feeling tired or having little energy lately, even after a good night's sleep?
Not really. I... I haven't noticed feeling particularly tired. I'm mostly just sitting around anyway, so... I don't know. I guess my energy is fine.
Would you say that you feel depressed most of the day, nearly every day, or does your mood vary quite a bit throughout the day?
I'm not sure... I haven't really noticed. The days just sort of... blur together lately. I don't really pay attention to whether it goes up or down. I guess it's just kind of always there.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?
I don't think so. I mean... I haven't really done anything to feel guilty about. I just go to work, come home... that's about it. So, no, not really.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, feeling restless or fidgety lately?

I don't think I'm restless. But... I guess maybe slow. My body just feels... slow. Like, even just sorting papers at my desk, or... walking to the corner store. It just takes more effort than it should. That's about it.
Would you say that your low mood lasts for most of the day, nearly every day, or does it come and go?

I guess it's... most days. I'll just sit at the kitchen table and... I don't know, it just feels like the color has gone out of everything. I have these old watercolor books, but... looking at them just makes me feel heavy now. I'm not interested in them. It just... stays like that, mostly.
Would you say that your low mood is present most of the day, nearly every day, or does it come and go in a way that you feel some significant relief during the day?
Like I said... it's most of the day. I don't really get any... relief from it, I guess. It just stays.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been... about three months, I suppose. Right around the time I started getting things ready to... well, leave the library. I've just felt this way, with the fog and the mood, most days since then.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or if you'd be better off just not being here?
No... no, I haven't. I don't really think about things like that. Just... what I told you already.
Would you say that you've lost interest or pleasure in almost all activities, even those you used to enjoy?
I don't really know about that... I suppose I still do my usual things. I read a bit, watch the news. I haven't really... noticed losing interest in them. I just do what I usually do.
Would you say that your low mood is present for most of the day, nearly every day, even when there's no particular reason for it?

I suppose so... yes. Most days I just find myself sitting at the kitchen table. It's like... well, like the color has just gone out of everything. Even my old watercolor books... they don't hold my interest anymore. Looking at them just makes me feel heavy. So... yes, it's there most of the day.
Would you say that you’ve experienced a loss of interest or pleasure in almost all activities, even the ones you used to enjoy the most?

I... I thought I just answered that. I don't know about *all* activities. Like I said, the painting is... well, I just don't do it right now. But I still read the paper. I just... I don't really know what else to tell you about it.
Would you say that you've completely lost interest in your old watercolor books, or do you still have some interest in them but just don't feel like looking at them anymore?
I don't... I'm not really sure how to answer that. I just... I don't look at them right now. That's all.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in your old watercolor books, or do you still have some interest in them but just don’t feel like looking at them anymore?

I... didn't you just ask me that? I don't really know how to split hairs about it. I just... I don't open them. I don't know if the interest is completely gone or not. They just stay on the shelf. That's really all there is to it.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in your old watercolor books, or do you still have some interest in them but just don’t feel like looking at them anymore?
I... look, you're asking me the exact same thing again. I don't have a different answer for you. I just don't look at them. I really don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Have you noticed any difficulties with thinking clearly or concentrating on tasks lately?

I suppose... yes, that's actually why I came in. My mind just feels... foggy. I sit down with my old cataloguing notes and I just... I can't keep my place. Or even decide what to do next. It's just... hard to think.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in your old watercolor books, or do you still have some interest in them but just don’t feel like looking at them anymore?

I... did we go backwards? You keep asking me about the books. 

I really don't know how else to explain it. I just... I don't open them anymore. I don't know about the interest part, or how to measure that. I just don't look at them. I don't have a different answer for you.
Would you say that you’ve lost interest in most of the things you used to enjoy, even the ones you really liked before?
I... I don't know. I guess so. I just don't do much of anything right now.
